text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki ran the Japanese Derby to the 
finish. Though showing fatigue over a 
distance beyond her aptitude, her 
performance deeply moved the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That junior Umamusume is also moved. "I 
want to see just a little more of her"... 
she thinks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up at last is the long-distance race, 
the Kikuka Sho. The Trainer worries about 
the even longer distance, but Fuji Kiseki 
is determined to overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With strong rivals awaiting her at the 
Kikuka Sho, the days of racing through 
summer have begun!
